breaking_changes.BC_description: In version 3.0.0, the methods `.parse` and `.unparse` were removed from the library to keep the library focused on UUID generation and to exclude functionality related to UUID validation and string-buffer conversion. This change breaks any code that uses these methods to convert between UUID strings and binary buffer representations.
Reference: Issue: Parse/unparse methods removed in v3??
breaking_changes.Adaptation_method: Remove usage of `.parse` and `.unparse`. To convert a UUID buffer to a string (unparse), use an alternative library such as `uuid-parse` (https://github.com/zefferus/uuid-parse). Example: `require('uuid-parse').unparse(buffer)`. For parsing a UUID string into a buffer, use the same library: `require('uuid-parse').parse(uuidString)`. Alternatively, implement custom conversion logic using standard string and buffer operations.
